observations: Red Cummins QSB 6.7 engine with a large red painted cylinder head.
The engine is mounted on a blue metal stand.
A yellow handwheel is visible on the right side.
The engine appears to be in a workshop or yard environment.
A watermark 'JIGGERS EQUIPMENT SALES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The exterior paint is clean, but the internal condition and cleanliness of the cylinders cannot be determined from a single photo.
The engine has been used and is not a new factory unit.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A video showing a compression test or a video of the engine running with a smoke machine.
A clear photo of the oil pan and the underside of the engine.
A photo of the timing cover and the belt.
A photo of the fuel lines and the fuel filter.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the engine running to confirm it is not a static photo.
Photo of the oil pan and the underside of the engine to check for missing seals.
Photo of the timing cover and the timing belt.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
